about: W2 dressing of Station Zero's spawn zone and the three zones a player reaches first (the build plan's order: W2's Fare Hall, then W3a's Cordon, Escalator Hall, Arcade). Every group says what it is in the story (docs/station-zero/02-WORLD.md section 4, wiki pages). Stock models of the template map only; architecture as solids; signs as fitted panels. Built by szdress.py.

decon_corridor.note: Lodestar's foam decontamination corridor (the Decon Foam trap's tent): two tarp walls on posts, a tin roof, a spray bar, open at both ends. Local x along the corridor.

items.note: spray bar

staging_tent.note: Lodestar's staging tent over the PLAZA hoist: tarp walls on three sides (open to local -x), the yellow hoist frame over the Victorian tube mouth, the crews' kit. Origin = the hatch.

memorial.note: Candles, notes and presents at the barrier, replaced each week for a year by a woman nobody sees (wiki the-cordon). One blue balloon from New Year's Eve tied to the barrier.

flood.note: a sodium floodlight on its stand, pointing down into the bowl

banquet_table.note: a trestle of the inauguration banquet: three tables end to end, chairs pushed back or knocked over when the guests went down to board at 23:30; glasses and bottles still on it. Local x along the table.

token_booth.note: a 1931 token booth refitted in 1978: a dark counter base, wired glass on three sides, a token machine at its side and the clerk's register still open. Opens to local +x.

items.note: the night's takings, never collected

column.note: one of the Fare Hall's three 1931 columns: charcoal tile to the dado, white tile above, a steel band

shop_mouth.note: a 1978 shop front: the roll shutter left half up, a neon strip under it. Origin = middle of the bay mouth on the passage line; local +x into the shop (north)

planter_island.note: a 1978 planter island in the middle of the underpass: the flowers dead a year, a bench back to back each side, an ashtray bin. Local x along the passage.

cabinet_island.note: the underpass's own arcade corner: four cabinets back to back, screens dead, a table game and its stool
